mapper.select: SELECT over_delivery_policy FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{_parameter, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'
SELECT delivery_plan_mode FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{_parameter, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

SELECT h.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, h.customer_id AS customerId, h.status AS status, h.delivery_place AS deliveryPlace, h.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod FROM tb_sales_order_hd h WHERE h.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' FOR UPDATE OF h
mapper.sql: ph.sales_delivery_plan_id AS salesDeliveryPlanId, ph.tenant_id AS tenantId, ph.plan_no AS planNo, ph.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, oh.order_dt AS orderDt, oh.customer_id AS customerId, c.customer_code AS customerCode, c.customer_name AS customerName, ph.created_by AS createdBy

FROM tb_sales_delivery_plan_hd ph JOIN tb_sales_order_hd oh ON oh.sales_order_id = ph.sales_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = ph.tenant_id JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = oh.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = oh.tenant_id
mapper.select: SELECT pd.sales_delivery_plan_detail_id AS salesDeliveryPlanDetailId, pd.sales_delivery_plan_id AS salesDeliveryPlanId, pd.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, pd.sales_order_detail_id AS salesOrderDetailId, pd.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, pd.line_no AS lineNo, pd.plan_dt AS planDt, pd.planned_qty AS plannedQty, pd.delivered_qty AS deliveredQty, pd.planned_qty - pd.delivered_qty AS remainingQty, od.order_qty AS orderQty, COALESCE(od.shipped_qty, 0) AS shippedQty FROM tb_sales_delivery_plan_dt pd JOIN tb_sales_order_dt od ON od.sales_order_detail_id = pd.sales_order_detail_id AND od.sales_order_id = pd.sales_order_id AND od.tenant_id = pd.tenant_id AND od.material_id = pd.material_id JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = pd.material_id AND m.tenant_id = pd.tenant_id WHERE pd.sales_delivery_plan_id = #{salesDeliveryPlanId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND pd.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY pd.line_no

SELECT od.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, od.sales_order_detail_id AS salesOrderDetailId, od.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.unit AS unit, od.line_no AS lineNo, od.order_qty AS orderQty, COALESCE(od.shipped_qty, 0) AS shippedQty, COALESCE(od.delivery_dt, oh.delivery_dt) AS planDt FROM tb_sales_order_dt od JOIN tb_sales_order_hd oh ON oh.sales_order_id = od.sales_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = od.material_id AND m.tenant_id = od.tenant_id WHERE od.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND od.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY od.line_no

INSERT INTO tb_sales_delivery_plan_dt ( sales_delivery_plan_id, tenant_id, sales_order_id, sales_order_detail_id, material_id, line_no, plan_dt, planned_qty, created_by ) VALUES ( #{salesDeliveryPlanId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{salesOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{salesOrderDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{materialId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{lineNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{planDt, jdbcType=DATE}, #{plannedQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) RETURNING sales_delivery_plan_detail_id
